requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court and county named in the caption - the court in which the charged offense is pending, and its county (State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal; your own case papers name both, and the instructions page says who can confirm them)

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the charge was placed on the dead docket

requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the GCIC OTN for the case, copied from your Georgia criminal history report where it appears - the proposed order needs it to be actionable by GCIC, and the packet is usable without it

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own statement of how this pending charge on your record has been a barrier

requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own first-hand account of how the pending charge has been a barrier - these lines are yours alone and nothing on them is written for you
